description: Implementation of the WMLCampaign class for Wesnoth Scenario Editor, managing campaign data, scenarios, icons, and export functionality.

classes.name: WMLCampaign
classes.description: Represents a campaign in Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including scenarios, icons, and export functionality.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new WMLCampaign instance with default values.

methods.name: dealloc
methods.description: Releases retained objects during deallocation.

methods.name: encodeWithCoder
methods.description: Encodes the campaign object for serialization.

methods.name: initWithCoder
methods.description: Initializes a campaign object from a decoder.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of scenarios in the campaign.

methods.name: getScenarioAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a scenario at a specific index.

methods.name: addScenario
methods.description: Adds a new scenario to the campaign and returns its index.

methods.name: deleteScenario
methods.description: Removes a scenario at a specified index.

methods.name: getActiveMap
methods.description: Returns the active map of the current scenario.

methods.name: setActiveScenario
methods.description: Sets the active scenario by index.

methods.name: getActiveScenario
methods.description: Returns the current active scenario.

methods.name: getActiveSide
methods.description: Returns the active side of the current scenario.

methods.name: getCharacters
methods.description: Returns the characters associated with the campaign.

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the campaign prefix string.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the campaign prefix string.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the campaign name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the campaign name.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the campaign icon image.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the campaign icon image.

methods.name: setDifficultyIcon
methods.description: Sets the difficulty icon for a specified difficulty level.

methods.name: getDifficultyIconForDifficulty
methods.description: Retrieves the difficulty icon for a specified difficulty level.

methods.name: setDifficultyDescription
methods.description: Sets the description text for a specified difficulty level.

methods.name: getDifficultyDescriptionForDifficulty
methods.description: Retrieves the description text for a specified difficulty level.

methods.name: exportToFolder
methods.description: Exports the campaign and its scenarios to a specified folder, including configuration and images.
